title: Midjourney AI Pricing Your Guide to Plans and Costs

facts.fact: Midjourney's monthly subscription plans start at $10 for the Basic plan.
facts.quote: monthly plans kicking off at $10 for the Basic plan and scaling up to $120 for the Mega plan

facts.fact: Midjourney's monthly subscription plans scale up to $120 for the Mega plan.
facts.quote: scaling up to $120 for the Mega plan

facts.fact: Midjourney offers a 20% discount when subscribers pay annually.
facts.quote: there's a 20% discount if you pay annually

facts.fact: Every Midjourney tier except the entry-level one includes unlimited Relax Mode generations.
facts.quote: Every tier, except for the entry-level one, also gets you unlimited "Relax Mode" generations

facts.fact: The Basic plan costs $10 per month on a monthly basis.
The Basic plan costs $8 per month when paid annually (20% off).
The Standard plan costs $30 per month on a monthly basis.
The Standard plan costs $24 per month when paid annually (20% off).
The Pro plan costs $60 per month on a monthly basis.
The Pro plan costs $48 per month when paid annually (20% off).
The Mega plan costs $120 per month on a monthly basis.
The Mega plan costs $96 per month when paid annually (20% off).
The Basic plan includes 3.3 hours of Fast GPU time per month, which the page says is about 200 images.
The Standard plan includes 15 hours of Fast GPU time per month, which the page says is about 900 images.
The Pro plan includes 30 hours of Fast GPU time per month, which the page says is about 1,800 images.
The Mega plan includes 60 hours of Fast GPU time per month, which the page says is about 3,600 images.
The Basic plan does not include Relax Mode.
facts.quote: But here’s the catch: there's no "Relax Mode."

facts.fact: The Pro plan's Stealth Mode keeps all of a subscriber's creations private.
facts.quote: This plan introduces "Stealth Mode," which keeps all your creations private

facts.fact: Per a third-party source the page cites, Midjourney's annual revenue reportedly rose from $50 million in 2022.
facts.quote: Midjourney’s annual revenue reportedly shot up from $50 million in 2022

facts.fact: Midjourney's annual revenue is estimated at $500 million in 2025, according to the page's reported figures.
The page states Midjourney's revenue grew 66.7% year over year, reaching an estimated $500 million in 2025.
Midjourney has a community of over 21 million registered users, per the page.
facts.quote: This surge is backed by a community of over 21 million registered users.

facts.fact: Midjourney ended its free trial, and it now offers only paid subscriptions.
facts.quote: The days of the free trial are long gone.

facts.fact: The article was published on March 23, 2026.
